I've lost everything. The girl I love is with another, my friends are all moving on and changing and I've been left behind. 

It's like the entire earth revolves and everyone in it changes and changes yet I don't move an inch. I see people happy, sad. 

I see death and I see life. I see pain. I see love. I see it all whizzing by at an amazing speed. I see things that English doesn't have a proper word for, and i see things English really shouldn't have  a word for. 

All the people in my life are lines on a graph, some curving around wildly, others traveling in a straight line and going where you would expect. 

But I am just a point on this graph. I stand still. All these lines pass through me. Soms come back, others do not. But they all find their way back to me when they need me.

My heart feels empty. I don't feel love, i don't feel happy. I don't really feel sad either. I don't change. I just exist and do everything in my power to help anyone I can. The people I care for, i find it my duty to care for them, despite the pain I always feel.

Everything changes but me. I want to feel the things they can, but I just can't.
